name: journeys-beginning-draw-and-quest-counter
notes: Journey's Beginning (8ofid087a6, GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["8ofid087a6:0"]): "Draw a card. [Guo Jia Bonus] Put a quest counter on your champion." The starting champion (myField-0) is patched directly to Guo Jia, Chosen Disciple (j6dkdoxyqt) via patchMzId so IsGuoJiaBonus() reads true, without separately re-testing the real champion level-up flow. Journey's Beginning is played from hand (myHand-1!FSM! with this deck/seed) and its 3-reserve cost is paid with 3 Dungeon Guide from hand (moved to memory); both players then PASS the resulting EffectStack opportunity window (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/OpportunityLogic.php) so the activated ability actually resolves instead of leaving it stuck on the stack. Verified live: champion's Counters go from {} to {"quest":1}, and the deck count drops by exactly 1 (draw). Break/restore verified: commenting out the Draw()+AddQuestCounters() body makes the fixture fail (deck count stays 13, no quest counter) and restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: [Guo Jia Bonus] Put a quest counter on your champion.
